description: The Dell World 2012 application is packed full of features to help manage your conference events, speakers, documents, contacts and more. At Dell World, you will discover how to master the forces shaping today's IT landscape. Engage in insightful conversations, experience breakthrough solutions and identify opportunities for gaining an advantage in today's environment. Dell World 2012 conference is held in Austin, Texas on December 11th - 13 2012 at the Austin Convention Center. (end support after dell world 2012)
